description: Haltestellen Dresden - Barrierefreiheit is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dresden.de. All bus and tram stops in the city area served by regular regular services are shown. If available, further information on accessibility, the bus and tram lines running at the stop platform as well as photos of the individual stop platforms are available in the maptip. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Bus stops Dresden - Accessibility" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2021-04-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
